limitations: These controlled RGB stills cannot validate Android YUV/RGBA conversion, sensor timestamps, rotation/mirror implementation, lifecycle, physical camera domain shift or real video tracking. App pixel tests and emulator camera tests are separate. Extra NMS cannot recover proposals already suppressed inside model. Float vs int8 artifacts can differ beyond quantization; not isolated quantizer causal inference.
